verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a management CLI (`solo2 list`, `update`, LED admin), firmware build and flash tooling, and support for standard protocols (FIDO2/WebAuthn, OATH, PIV, OpenPGP). None of it documents an official SDK or library for embedding the key in your own desktop or mobile apps. The only related tooling, solo-python, is described as a CLI and is reported broken against current python-fido2. A hardware security key vendor could plausibly ship such SDKs, so the axis applies, but there is no evidence this one does.
